text:
Rhea: Aperture Health pilot wrap — they agreed to a short case study + a 30-min webinar. Need hero quote + signed release before any social.

Omar: They reported a 3.9x throughput uplift on batch billing jobs and ~35% lower inference cost. Can we confirm exact phrasing?

Dmitri (Aperture Health): Confirmed. We'll share the benchmark workbook under NDA. Prefer 'approximately 35%' publicly. Happy with a Wed webinar window in 2 weeks.

Lina (Legal): Paste proposed quote and upload the workbook. We'll prepare the release with an embargo option. Also include translation approval if localizing.

Rhea: Draft hero: "With Redwood, Aperture Health achieved a 3.9x throughput increase and approximately 35% lower inference cost during our pilot."

Lina (Legal): '3.9x' + 'approximately 35%' OK if workbook attached. We'll need the measurement window (e.g., 14-day run) in the release text: "Benchmarking conducted over a 14-day production-like run; data provided by Aperture Health under NDA." Also request signatory.

Dmitri (Aperture Health): Measurement window is 14 days. I'll upload the sheet and arrange for our VP to sign the release. We prefer a 5-day embargo after webinar.

Kai (Events): If webinar, suggest Wed 10am PT. Marketing needs signed release + final quote 72h before promotion.

sales-ops: When publish goes live, route demo form submissions to Aperture Health AE and tag leads "aperture-pilot". I'll create SFDC campaign and webhook; need final publish date.

Rhea: Action items: 1) Dmitri uploads workbook + signed release, 2) Lina finalizes redline, 3) Kai creates webinar page, 4) Omar drafts copy. Target: publish the blog + webinar in 2 weeks (post-embargo).

Dmitri (Aperture Health): Uploading now: https://files.aperture/benchmarks/redwood-14d.xlsx (access granted). Signed release will follow.

Lina (Legal): Uploaded redline with embargo and data-source language: https://legal.redwood/redlines/5240001110. Please confirm signatory and attach signed PDF.

Omar: I'll draft the short blog + 3-tweet thread and post for approvals tomorrow 9am PT.

Rhea: Great — once signed, I'll open the copy-approval thread and tag @sales-ops for campaign ID.

Dmitri (Aperture Health): VP signed and PDF uploaded. Looking forward to the webinar. :rocket:
